text: If you decided to become a real-world supervillain tomorrow, your biggest enemy would not be a superhero. It would be your contractor, your electric bill, and basic physics.

Every classic villain starts with a secret volcano lair or an underground bunker. Just excavating and reinforcing a multi-level concrete fortress inside solid rock costs roughly one point eight billion dollars, plus forty million every year for industrial ventilation so your staff does not suffocate.

Good luck keeping that construction secret. Six thousand concrete mixer trucks driving up an active volcano tends to show up on satellite maps. Even worse, commercial and military infrared satellites scan the entire planet every single day.

A warm concrete dome pumping out megawatts of generator heat glows like a giant neon target on thermal cameras. Intelligence agencies would pinpoint your exact volcano coordinates within forty-eight hours.
And the worst part? Even inside a dormant volcano, the local county inspector would still fine you for building a shark tank without a plumbing permit.
